title: My grandmother's garden
instructions: Ece büyükannesinin bahçesini anlatıyor. Bitkilere ve yaptıklarına dikkat et.

script.speaker: s
script.text: My grandmother has a beautiful garden behind her house.

script.speaker: s
script.text: She grows tomatoes, peppers, beans and lots of flowers.

script.speaker: s
script.text: She works in the garden every morning, even though she is eighty-two.

script.speaker: s
script.text: In summer, she gives vegetables to all her neighbours.

script.speaker: s
script.text: She says gardening keeps her young.

questions.prompt: When does she work in the garden?
questions.evidence: She works in the garden every morning

questions.prompt: What does she do in summer?
options: She gives vegetables to her neighbours.
questions.evidence: she gives vegetables to all her neighbours.
